verdict.rationale: The only evidence that Scribe applies punctuation is a community report, which also notes a formatting flaw: missing spaces after punctuation in German. Nothing documents casing, number formatting, or a toggle to disable formatting. The natural-language edit instruction is a separate post-processing feature, not a formatting switch, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: documented punctuation/casing/number-formatting behavior, a parameter to turn formatting off, inverse text normalization details, independent corroboration of formatting quality.

support.subject: As a developer, transcripts come back with punctuation, casing, and number formatting applied, and I can turn the formatting off

citations.quote: Scribe often leaves out the space after punctuation
